mapper.sql: c.id, c.name, c.code, c.description, c.teacher_id, c.duration_minutes, c.exam_enabled, c.create_time, c.update_time, u.real_name AS teacher_name, q.question_count AS question_count, q.total_score AS total_score

FROM course c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.teacher_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS question_count, COALESCE(SUM(score), 0) AS total_score FROM question GROUP BY course_id ) q ON q.course_id = c.id

where.if: AND (c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY c.create_time DESC, c.id DESC
